verdict.rationale: Open WebUI has shared Channels and can accept posts from external services, so gating inbound messages is a fair question for it. However, the evidence documents no sender allowlists, DM policies or mention gating for those messages. Its RBAC roles (Admin, User, Pending) control who can use the web UI, which is an adjacent control and not gating of inbound messages.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, inbound messages are gated — sender allowlists, DM policies, mention gating — so only people I approve can drive my assistant
